stories.title: Flintshire residents offered free wellbeing course in Buckley
stories.summary: A free six-week wellbeing course is starting in Buckley on Tuesday 2 June, open to anyone aged 16 and over who lives in Flintshire. stories.title: Cannabis plants seized by North Wales Police more than double in four years
stories.summary: The number of cannabis plants recovered by North Wales Police has more than doubled in four years. Figures published under freedom of information rules show officers seized around 5,900 plants in the 13 months to 30 September 2025. stories.title: Witness appeal after single-vehicle crash at Holywell Golf Course
stories.summary: North Wales Police are appealing for witnesses after a single-vehicle collision at Holywell Golf Course on Saturday evening. stories.title: Man charged with imitation firearm offences after Saltney Ferry incident
stories.summary: A 36-year-old Saltney Ferry man has been charged with four offences after North Wales Police attended a property on Saltney Terrace on Monday afternoon. stories.title: Flintshire households face £221 energy bill rise from July
stories.summary: Households in Flintshire on default energy tariffs face a £221 rise in their annual bills from July, after the regulator Ofgem raised the energy price cap by 13 per cent.
